page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced family running on a KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, provisioning 16 dedicated vCPUs. Memory capacity totals 32.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 processor-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Storage and networking configurations emphasize network-based resources. The instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational file systems and persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 6 Gbps. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the specification.

Because the resource profile provides dedicated compute cores coupled with a modest memory footprint, resource efficiency favors compute-bound tasks over memory-heavy workloads. The instance fits batch data processing, distributed compilation, video transcoding, and web application serving where memory requirements do not exceed 2.0 GB per core.
